fusions.name: Man-Catcher
fusions.desc: You rush a target up to 6 tiles away and catch it between the tines for 12 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Portcullis Drop
fusions.desc: Drives tines down in a ring around you, dealing 26 piercing damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Palisade
fusions.desc: Plants a row of tines 5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that enemies cannot pass.

fusions.name: Nowhere Left to Run
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 12% against enemies below 50% health.
